' ---- Headline block (new) -------------------------------------------------

' Three rows -- EM / EL / Combined -- each showing denominator, "completed"
' count, and "completed" %. "Completed" here mirrors the existing
' "Not completed (total)" complement already used throughout this sheet:
' Green + Pink + Light Green (i.e. denominator minus Orange/Draft/Voided/
' Missed). This is the single number the department meeting comes for, so
' it must be visible without scrolling -- bold, 14pt for the percentage.
Private Sub WriteHeadlineBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, _
        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "HEADLINE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Category"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 4)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, _
        ByRef chart1AnchorRow As Long, ByRef chart2AnchorRow As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- HEADLINE BLOCK (new) ----
    WriteHeadlineBlock ws, r, emEnc, missedEM, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, _
        elEnc, missedEL, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen
    chart1AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 1 (~420x260pt, well under 20 default-height rows)

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    chart2AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 2

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Unmatched "NCID" Point of Care values warning (PART 3.1) ----
    If Not unmatchedNCIDWards Is Nothing Then
        If unmatchedNCIDWards.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "POINT OF CARE VALUES CONTAINING 'NCID' NOT IN THE CONFIGURED LIST " & _
                "(still counted normally -- check whether a new NCID ward needs adding to the Config " & _
                "sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim nk As Variant
            For Each nk In unmatchedNCIDWards.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(nk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNCIDWards(nk)
                r = r + 1
            Next nk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Low roster coverage: unmatched staff names (PART 4.1) ----
    If Not suppressTeamBlocks And rosterCoverage < 0.7 And rosterCoverage > 0 Then
        If Not unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
            If unmatchedNames.Count > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "LOW ROSTER COVERAGE (" & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
                    ") -- UNMATCHED STAFF NAMES (add these to the Config roster for the biggest gain)"
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
                r = r + 1

                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name (as it appears in this export)"
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
                ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
                r = r + 1

                Dim sortedNames As Variant
                sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
                Dim si As Long
                For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
                    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(sortedNames(si))
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
                    r = r + 1
                Next si
                r = r + 1
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- RECONCILIATION WATERFALL (moved to the bottom -- for checking, not for the meeting) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the meeting"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1
    WriteReconciliationWaterfall ws, r, waterfall, missedEM + missedEL + missedOther, _
        voidedTotal, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, emEnc, elEnc, otherEncCount

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 70
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
